**Changes:** the publisher's API was asked for the indicated section only. Response bodies are saved byte for byte, with no editing or JSON reserialization. The rest of each article is not included. `captures.json` and receipts are acquisition metadata produced here. Rendered responses include markup, captions and remote media references; no remote media bytes were downloaded. Section-only rendering can have unresolved references and resets edit-link numbering; the requested section and revision come from the API request/response, not edit links. Rendered templates can change even with a fixed article revision; these exact response hashes freeze the acquired rendering, not all transcluded templates forever.

The source sections contain factual selections and Wikipedia narrative, not copies of BFI/NBR criticism. Their license does not cover external articles, images, or original BFI/NBR pages. None of those page bodies or images is redistributed here. Redistribution/adaptation of the retained Wikipedia text must preserve attribution and the applicable CC BY-SA 4.0 obligations. The license is separate from the repository's MIT code license.
